title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Speedrun in 22:38, live at AGDQ2013
summary: Cosmo's 22:38 Ocarina of Time speedrun, performed live at AGDQ 2013. The runner uses a complex exploit to skip much of the game.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a showcase of the deep reverse-engineering and glitch knowledge behind speedrunning, and cite it for the wrongwarp trick.

quote.text: The level of reverse-engineering is impressive.
